title: Fallout 3 Janus Bear — James_B Temporal / REFR Lifecycle Falsification Gate
question: Can any source-bound teddy/gnome tableau be observed before the earliest possible James_B creation point, with an asset lifecycle proving that the tableau was not dynamically enabled/spawned only after James_B could exist?

james_source_upgrade.effect: The hypothetical James_B source can now be anchored to James's own physical Vault 112 session instead of an abstract generic user.

earliest_james_b_boundary.definition: James_B cannot exist earlier than the conditional 2277 pre-exit live-state capture described by SAVE JAMES.
earliest_james_b_boundary.rule: An object tableau that is demonstrably present before this boundary cannot have been initially placed by James_B unless a separate dynamic replacement or later restaging edge is proved.

zeta_temporal_discriminator.scene: Mothership Zeta Robot Assembly teddy + miniature intact garden gnome + miniature TV tableau
zeta_temporal_discriminator.abduction_start_model: DLC05MZ1QuestScript starts the DLC notification after the player is out of Vault 101 and performs the actual first abduction on proximity to AlienRadioBeaconREF.
zeta_temporal_discriminator.significance: A vanilla-compatible play order exists in which Mothership Zeta is entered before the conditional Vault 112 James_B capture point.
zeta_temporal_discriminator.not_yet_proved: The public scene description alone does not establish whether every component RefID is permanently enabled, enable-parented, script-spawned, replaced, or otherwise state-dependent.

decision_logic.not_a_falsifier: A pre-James-B accessible location whose tableau is explicitly spawned/enabled/replaced only after the James_B boundary.
decision_logic.effect_on_subset_hypothesis: H3 remains open for other exact scenes unless independently falsified or supported.

edge_classes: quest alias or stage side effect

memory_carrier_cross_gate.importance: Finding the missing James memory->carrier write edge would strengthen the existence mechanism for James_B but would not itself provide any teddy/gnome placement history.

canonical_lines_ru: Новая James-specific привязка Lounger #23 усиливает возможность определить источник James_B, но никак не даёт ему историю путешествий или право авторства над teddy/gnome сценами.

Mothership Zeta даёт первый сильный временной тест: корабль может быть достигнут до условного момента создания James_B, поэтому статически существующая там bear/gnome диорама была бы несовместима с James_B как первоначальным автором.
Чтобы это стало машинным опровержением, нужен exact RefID lifecycle: initially-disabled, enable parent, scripts и quest gating.
Даже если H2 'James_B расставил всё' будет опровергнута одной ранней сценой, H3 'James причастен к отдельному subset' останется открытой до поиска прямого placement edge.

next_gate.name: JANUS_BEAR_EXACT_SCENE_REFR_LIFECYCLE_AND_TEMPORAL_ORDER_v4.7
targets: Export exact teddy/gnome RefIDs for Robot Assembly, Presidential sub level, Old Olney and other high-value tableaux.
Export REFR lifecycle fields including initially-disabled and enable-parent relations.
Test whether the Robot Assembly tableau is observable before MQ04 without any later dynamic scene mutation.
Search all James identifiers against teddy/gnome references, ownership and scripts.
Publish H2 as temporally falsified only if at least one pre-James_B tableau receives exact static lifecycle binding.
